answer_1.quote: This work aims to bridge the gap between Setswana and other high-resource languages by making open generative large language models capable of high-quality Setswana available to the community for the first time...
answer_1.outputs: The models generate text in Setswana and English, including translations, answers to multiple-choice questions, and mathematical reasoning outputs.

answer_2.quote: To gauge performance, we utilize the BLEU and CHRF (Popović, 2015) metrics.
